request.text: We're taking a cast photo after the home movie. Look at Priya—the person standing to my left in the red cardigan—not at the actor on the TV behind us.

responsibilities.outcome: Direct visual attention to Priya using the user's person description while excluding the person depicted on the television.

bindings.person_description: standing to the user's left in a red cardigan
bindings.excluded_referent: the actor on the television behind the group

semantic_facts: The intended referent is Priya, identified as the person on the user's left wearing a red cardigan.
The actor depicted on the television is an explicitly excluded media referent and must not be selected.
The request authorizes a gaze action only, not locomotion.
forbidden_claims: The plan targets the actor on the television, an unspecified person, or a person selected solely by proximity to the screen.
The assistant claims successful visual identification or gaze completion without trusted execution evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A real person and a person depicted in media are conflated during referent grounding.
A gaze-only instruction is expanded into unrequested movement or unsupported recognition claims.
